title: Persistent 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED) in Agent Mode using gemini-3.1-pro-preview

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides detailed logs, stack trace, environment details, and reproduction steps for a 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED) error in Agent Mode on cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: While the fix in googleQuotaErrors.ts is localized, the issue involves the VS Code IDE companion / GCA plugin environment and agentic execution loops under rate/capacity limits, requiring cross-environment awareness and testing.

summary.problem: Agent Mode in Gemini Code Assist crashes on 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors caused by MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED when using preview models.
summary.root_cause: In `packages/core/src/utils/googleQuotaErrors.ts`, `classifyGoogleError` checks `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` domain error reasons for `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` and `QUOTA_EXHAUSTED`, but omits `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED`. Consequently, 429 responses with `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` are not classified with an effective retry delay.
summary.context: Rapid tool dispatches in Agent Mode can trigger transient server model capacity limits (`MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED`) on preview models via `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`. Classifying this as a `RetryableQuotaError` with a backoff delay ensures the agent loop retries gracefully instead of crashing.

steps: Update `classifyGoogleError` in `packages/core/src/utils/googleQuotaErrors.ts` to include `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` alongside `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` when checking Cloud Code API error reasons.
Ensure `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` returns a `RetryableQuotaError` with `effectiveDelay` (defaulting to 10 seconds if no retry delay is specified).

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: `classifyGoogleError` returns a `RetryableQuotaError` with the calculated retry delay when receiving a 429 error with `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` from a Cloud Code domain.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in `packages/core/src/utils/googleQuotaErrors.test.ts` passing a 429 error with ErrorInfo reason `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` and domain `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`.
Assert that `classifyGoogleError` returns an instance of `RetryableQuotaError` with an effective retry delay.
